_about: The facts of the Olivia format that a receiver must match bit for bit, transcribed with the line each stands on. This is the pattern data/rsid/rsid-codes.json and data/psk31/varicode.csv set: facts of a published format, cited, not a port of anybody's code (work instruction 361 decision H). Hamlet's demodulator reads every number here through OliviaData and carries none of them as a literal.
source: Pawel Jalocha, pj_mfsk.h, pj_fht.h and pj_gray.h as shipped in fldigi src/include/jalocha/, GPL-3, master branch 2026-09-14 (assets/reference/SOURCE.md lines 3 to 5); the copies read are under assets/reference/jalocha/

upper_half_negated.cite: pj_mfsk.h:1161-1164: a character below SymbolsPerBlock sets +1 at its own index, one at or above it sets -1 at its index less SymbolsPerBlock

walsh_inverse_kernel.cite: pj_fht.h:40-45, the IFHT butterfly applied at pj_mfsk.h:1165: the lower output is the lower input less the upper, the upper output their sum; rows are outputs, columns inputs

scrambling_shift_per_character.cite: pj_mfsk.h:1185 and :1335 nShift = 13 for Olivia, applied as FreqBit * nShift at :1192 and :1337

scrambling_rule.value: the code bit for character c at symbol t is bit ((c * shift) + t) modulo symbols_per_block of the code, and a set bit negates that symbol's Walsh value

tone_bit_rotation_per_symbol.cite: pj_mfsk.h:1196-1204: character c's value at symbol t sets bit (c + t) modulo bits_per_symbol of that symbol, the rotation stepping by one per symbol

negative_sets_the_bit.cite: pj_mfsk.h:1195 if (FHT_Buffer[TimeBit] < 0) the bit is set

symbol_to_tone.cite: pj_mfsk.h:168 Symbol = GrayCode(Symbol) before the tone is chosen; pj_gray.h:11-12 GrayCode(Binary) = Binary ^ (Binary >> 1). The table is that rule for symbols 0 to 31, which serves every variant of up to 32 tones; tone k sits k spacings above the first tone (pj_mfsk.h:172)

analysis_window_symbols.cite: pj_mfsk.h:121 and :804 SymbolSepar = SymbolLen / 2: each symbol is shaped with a raised cosine SymbolLen long (:227) and the next starts SymbolSepar later

null_character.cite: pj_mfsk.h:1825-1826: a block with fewer characters queued than it carries is filled with character 0, which is idle and not text

variant_rule.value: tone_spacing_hz = bandwidth_hz / tones; symbol_seconds = 1 / tone_spacing_hz; first_tone_offset_hz = -(tones - 1) / 2 * tone_spacing_hz
variant_rule.cite: pj_mfsk.h:1719-1723 and :2060-2063: SymbolLen = 2^(BitsPerSymbol + 7 - log2(Bandwidth / 125)) at 8000 Hz, carriers 2 bins of SymbolLen apart (:68, :717) and symbols SymbolLen / 2 apart, so the spacing and the symbol rate are both Bandwidth / Tones; fldigi's olivia.cxx places the carriers with fc_offset = Bandwidth * (1 - 0.5 / Tones) / 2 below the center and the +1 bin of :1723 puts their middle on it (assets/reference/olivia-fixture-generator.cpp line 13)
